item.description: ### Changed - **Cursor usage now shows by default.** In 0.5.1 you had to find a switch in Settings and turn it on, which meant most people upgraded and saw no Cursor usage at all — while the Claude and Codex bars have always appeared without being asked for. It's still a switch, so you can turn it off; it just starts on now. Nothing happens on a Mac without Cursor: Perch only asks Cursor for your usage while a Cursor session is actually open, so if you don't use Cursor it never makes the call.
